description: This file implements functions related to atomic counters in HLSL, including generating atomic counter function names, emitting HLSL code for atomic counter operations, and managing atomic counter names for bindings.

classes.name: AtomicCounterFunctionHLSL
classes.description: Class for generating and managing atomic counter functions in HLSL.

methods.name: AtomicCounterFunctionHLSL::useAtomicCounterFunction
methods.description: Returns the HLSL function name for a given atomic counter operation name.

methods.name: AtomicCounterFunctionHLSL::atomicCounterFunctionHeader
methods.description: Outputs the HLSL code for atomic counter functions based on stored function names and types.

methods.name: getAtomicCounterNameForBinding
methods.description: Generates a unique atomic counter name string for a given binding index.
